name: Grand Theft Auto V
overview: Set in the sun-drenched, morally bankrupt Los Santos, three very different men find their lives colliding in a desperate bid for the American Dream. Michael De Santa, a legendary bank robber living a miserable middle-aged life in witness protection, Franklin Clinton, a smart young street hustler looking to escape dead-end gang life and Trevor Philips, Michael’s violent and unpredictable former partner. Trapped between corrupt federal agents and their own explosive personalities, this unlikely trio must pull off a series of high-stakes, dangerous heists to survive.
